test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Amit, the stand-up comedian, delivered a __hilarious__ performance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Serious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hilarious"** means extremely funny or amusing, often causing laughter. (हंसी से भरपूर)

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so hilarious that the audience couldn't stop laughing.
 
 
 
• **"Serious"** refers to being solemn, grave, or not humorous; it is the opposite of funny or lighthearted. (गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher's serious tone indicated the importance of the discussion.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'hilarious'** is **'serious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spleen** (क्रोध या चिढ़): Refers to feelings of anger or spite.

 
 
• **Example:** He vented his spleen on the employees after the failed project.
 
 
 
• **Ideological** (वैचारिक): Relating to a system of ideas or ideals, especially concerning political or social issues.
 
 
• **Example:** Their ideological differences often led to heated debates.
 
 
 
• **Persistent** (लगातार): Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action despite difficulties.
 
 
• **Example:** Her persistent efforts finally paid off with a promotion.
